mode: web-e2e (Playwright Chromium, fresh Vite, VITE_E2E_MODE) + visual/code audit
summary: Fresh-Vite product audit passed 16/16 Chromium checks: 9 active-user portrait routes, legacy settings redirect, onboarding, admin and 4 landscape routes. There was no blank screen, NaN, horizontal overflow, uncaught page error or unexpected console.error. The stale blank settings screenshots were a harness timing error: #/settings redirects to #/profile; the audit now waits for the destination and captures Profile. Visual/code review found no release-blocking web defect, but typography still has 112 labels at 8-10.5 px and personalization is 11 single accents rather than the requested three coherent three-role palettes.

orange.route: workout, history, cycles, profile, plan, analytics, Strava
orange.title: Functional microcopy is below the planned readable floor
orange.evidence: 112 occurrences of 8-10.5 px across 53 files; key examples: WorkoutDay session stats 9 px, CycleTile 8 px, ExerciseCard record label 9 px
orange.suggestion: Introduce semantic type tokens and migrate screen-by-screen with 320 px, 100/150/200% text-scale, keyboard and landscape regression checks.

orange.title: Avatar personalization is an accent picker, not a three-color palette system
orange.evidence: accent-theme.ts defines 11 independent accents and applies one hue to primary/ring/accent; avatar-accent.ts only ranks up to three existing accent IDs
orange.suggestion: Ship a versioned primary/secondary/tertiary PaletteTheme with three named defaults, privacy-safe avatar proposal and lossless migration of all existing accents.

yellow.title: Root routes repeat context in the top bar and page heading
yellow.suggestion: Keep one screen title and use the second line for context or an action.

fixed_during_audit: Release-audit harness now tests #/settings as a redirect and captures the rendered #/profile destination instead of a transient blank frame.
Added a real workout-route popup exit regression test in Chromium and WebKit.
top_fixes: Complete physical iOS and Android background/resume, interrupted workout, export/share and restart recovery.
Raise critical 8-10.5 px labels through a semantic typography migration with text-scale QA.
Replace the accent list with three coherent three-role palettes while preserving every existing user choice.
